periods.summary: Nagi, called Alice, is Shizuku's roommate and confidant. She helps Shizuku style herself for the outing with Ikki, warns Ikki that his endurance masks unheard pain, detects the Rebellion attack, hides with Ikki through Shadow Walk, coordinates with Shizuku by text, and uses Shadow Bind to stop Ikki from rushing out prematurely. She later wins her first selection battle quickly and gives Shizuku space to let Ikki and Stella be together.

key_events.summary: Counsels Shizuku about loving Ikki and competing with Stella.
Uses shadows to hide with Ikki, contact Kurono, and prevent a premature rescue attempt.
Explains to Stella and Shizuku how Ikki's pressure has finally erupted.

periods.gender: transfeminine / male body, girl identity in text

status.selection_battle_record: undefeated enough to be discussed as notable first-year

personality.summary: Playfully teasing and socially perceptive, but inwardly distrustful of human nature because of his own past.
personality.inner_conflict: He admires Ikki, Stella and Shizuku's ability to love or trust directly while feeling his own heart is darker.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Friend; warns him Ayase's message may be a trap but respects his choice.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Close companion and usual training partner.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Teases her and later discovers her secret relationship with Ikki.

periods.summary: Nagi supports the group during Ikki and Stella's winning streak and notices Ayase's stalker presence early. Before Ikki's rooftop meeting, Nagi warns him that Ayase may be plotting because she must beat him to reach Seven Stars. Ikki's trust makes Nagi reflect on his own cynicism. In the epilogue he catches Ikki and Stella about to kiss, confirms their secret relationship, promises not to spread it, and gleefully asks for front-row viewing rights.

key_events.summary: Had noticed Ayase tracking Ikki and stayed quiet because Ikki noticed too.
Warns Ikki to be ready to sever ties if Ayase betrays him.
Interrupts Ikki and Stella's attempted kiss and agrees to keep their relationship secret.

杀人馆历代最高分合格者

status.current: named as Hagun representative but secretly prepares Akatsuki's pre-festival operation

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Closest emotional confidant; comforts her after her loss.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend who discusses Shizuku's battle and Ikki's scandal with her.
relationships.akatsuki: Secret collaborators; a phone contact calls him comrade and Black Rose.

periods.summary: Nagi appears as Alice, the perceptive friend who explains Shizuku and Toka's duel, cares for Shizuku after her defeat, and discusses the scandal with Stella and Shizuku. His gentle persona contrasts with the epilogue reveal: during the representative ceremony he is absent, and at a deserted underpass he speaks with an Akatsuki contact using a non-Hagun handbook. The call identifies him as the Killing House's top graduate and as Black Rose, an assassin ready to act even though Shizuku's failure to qualify was unexpected. This reframes his friendly school role as an infiltration cover.

key_events.summary: Analyzes the battle and later comforts Shizuku.
Participates in the cafeteria discussion of Ikki's situation.
Privately revealed as Black Rose and an Akatsuki actor.

abilities: student knight ability not foregrounded in this volume

personality.summary: Attentive and protective toward Shizuku, while also a strong enough close-combat partner to dominate her in practice.

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Pulls Shizuku back before she enters the hallway underdressed and later spars with her in the forest.

status.current: defects from Akatsuki, survives Wallenstein, then withdraws from Seven Stars out of responsibility
status.secret_revealed: was planted at Hagun to earn trust and neutralize Hagun's strongest students with Shadow Bind

personality.summary: Warm and stylish on the surface, but scarred by orphanage trauma and trained as an assassin; ultimately chooses Shizuku's hopes over Akatsuki's plan.
personality.inner_conflict: He tries to believe that love and morality are illusions, yet cannot discard the childhood vow to become a 'cool adult' who protects others.

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Roommate and chosen little sister; her acceptance makes him choose redemption and remain by her side.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Friend whose dream he chooses not to destroy; asks Ikki to cooperate in countering Akatsuki.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Stabs her with Fantasy Form to silence her investigation, then hides her until Nango rescues her.
relationships.yuri-orphan: Childhood partner and co-leader whose death and last request shape his life.
relationships.wallenstein: Rebellion mentor who bought and trained him after the orphan tragedy; later punishes his defection.

periods.summary: Volume 05 exposes Alice's past as a northern orphan co-leader with Yuri and several younger children. After officials and mafia violence destroyed that family, Wallenstein recruited him into Rebellion as the assassin Black Shadow Killer. In the present, Alice has infiltrated Hagun for Akatsuki and initially stabs Kagami to stop her discovery. On the bus back to Hagun he reveals the scheme, admits he was meant to use Shadow Bind from behind, and instead asks Hagun to use his double-agent position to ambush Akatsuki. Amane's foresight ruins the plan and Alice is captured, but Shizuku rescues him from Wallenstein. Shizuku still calls him her sister, allowing Alice to accept staying beside her and protecting the people she loves.

key_events.summary: His childhood family, Yuri's death and Wallenstein's recruitment are revealed.
He silences Kagami after she identifies Akatsuki's infiltrators.
He confesses on the bus and turns his planned surprise attack against Akatsuki.
Shizuku rescues him and affirms that he remains her important sister.

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Meets him during Moroboshi's dinner invitation and playfully unsettles him.

periods.summary: After defecting from Akatsuki's plan in the previous volume, Alice remains around Shizuku and Ikki rather than entering the tournament. He helps Shizuku with her formal dress, jokes with Moroboshi during the Osaka dinner outing, and reads Ikki's excitement before the first-round duel. His presence also clarifies that he is trying to repay Kagami and repair his place among Hagun's students.

key_events.summary: Prepares Shizuku and warns Ikki to be careful of Akatsuki.
Joins Ikki and Shizuku at the Moroboshi family restaurant.

abilities: shadow manipulation, not directly used here

status.current: supports Ikki and Shizuku as observer rather than tournament fighter

personality.summary: Wry, protective and perceptive; he uses humor to steady Ikki while offering realistic threat assessments from his underworld experience.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Close friend; encourages him in the bath and steers him away from obsessing over Amane before the Byakuya match.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Close friend; believes Shizuku likely has a real plan to counter Amane.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend whose battle he analyzes, comparing her anti-reflection tactic to Ikki's earlier fight with Smile.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Observes and speaks with her while watching Stella's match.
relationships.byakuya-jounosaki: Byakuya had researched him as a potential Hagun representative and correctly reads his coffee preference.

periods.summary: Nagi watches Stella's four-on-one battle with Shizuku and Kiriko, explaining that Stella may be trying to imitate Ikki's high-speed solution against Smile's reflection. His assassin background makes him worry that Tatara's eyesight may defeat that plan. After Amane's reveal, Nagi later joins Ikki in the bath and advises him not to overthink an abnormal person's motives. He points out that Amane and Ikki cannot meet before the semifinals and that Shizuku may defeat Amane first, adding that Shizuku's confidence likely rests on a real countermeasure. He also helps Ikki identify the danger of Byakuya's data-based insight after Byakuya demonstrates White Hand.

key_events.summary: Witnesses Amane's true power reveal and later helps Ikki process it.
Meets Byakuya in the bathhouse and receives a correctly chosen coffee via White Hand.

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Roommate and confidant; takes her to a bar, listens to her pain and later nudges her into testing Stella.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Co-host for the special edition despite being dragged into it through guilt tactics.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Teases and advises her, including about the otome game.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Friend whose relationship with Stella causes Shizuku's turmoil.

periods.summary: Alice serves as both narrator and facilitator. In the frame story Kagami recruits him as co-host. In Shizuku's first-drink episode he takes her to a quiet bar, handles her drunkenness, hears her fear that she should relinquish Ikki, and tells her she need not discard her love. After Stella and Ikki's relationship becomes public, he finds Shizuku depressed in their messy room and deliberately reframes the situation as a family duty to test Stella's suitability, restoring Shizuku's energy. His comments show he has already chosen Hagun and Shizuku over Rebellion by that time.

key_events.summary: Is pulled into Kagami's special-edition wall-newspaper narration.
Guides Shizuku through her first bar visit and an emotional confession about Ikki.
Encourages Shizuku to turn despair into a test of Stella's suitability.

status.current: helps Sara dress and later accompanies Shizuku for pre-match preparations
status.condition: absent from stands when Shizuku's match is called

personality.summary: Stylish, teasing and perceptive, able to judge moral rot by hard-earned instincts.
core_traits: empathetic toward those forced into darkness

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Close friend; Ikki asks him to style Sara before the match.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Closest companion; he sits with her, follows her for final preparations, and is expected to support her against Amane.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: He styles her, teaches basic makeup and recognizes she lacks the rotten smell of willful evil despite Rebellion ties.
relationships.stella-vermillion: He deliberately provokes Stella's competitive pride so she will try harder rather than rely on being Ikki's girlfriend.

periods.summary: Alice meets Ikki and Shizuku at the dome exit after Ikki asks for help dressing Sara. He uses shadow stealth to avoid the crowd and takes Sara through cosmetics and clothing, using his Shadow Spot hideout for privacy. He judges that Sara is not malicious like many Rebellion criminals and listens to her explanation of accepting surgery and support from Rebellion as a transaction. He selects an outfit that works within Sara's extremely weak stamina and reframes her lack of fashion interest as a chance to compete for Ikki's attention, which also provokes Stella into self-reflection. Later he leaves with Shizuku for her pre-match preparation and is not in the stands when her match is supposed to begin.

key_events.summary: Styles Sara and hears about her transactional link to Rebellion.
Is notably absent from the stands when Shizuku and Amane fail to enter.

periods.time: Before Shizuku's third-round match through the delayed final setup
periods.label: 陪珠雫共犯的艾莉丝

status.current: recovers from Amane's counterattack and supports Shizuku during Ikki's crisis
status.discipline: co-conspirator in Shizuku's pre-match attack; receives a three-month public-match ban and written apology order

personality.summary: Worldly and protective; he knows Shizuku's plan is wrong yet chooses not to let her bear it alone.
values: protect friends even when unable to stop them

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Closest companion in the incident; accepts becoming her accomplice because he cannot leave her isolated.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Feels apologetic for helping a plan Ikki would oppose, then supports Ikki's survival and final chance.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Attempts to restrain Amane with Shadow Stitch but is disabled when a flicker of darkness breaks the shadow lock.

periods.summary: Alice tries to dissuade Shizuku from a pre-match ambush because it will likely cost her the tournament and possibly school, but he recognizes that she will act alone if refused. He uses Shadow Walk to carry her into Amane's waiting room and Shadow Stitch to restrain Amane after the first attack fails. Amane's luck creates a brief loss of light that cancels the shadow restraint, and Amane pierces Alice with many Azure blades. Alice later wakes with Shizuku, reassures Ikki before the semifinal, calls for help when Ikki collapses after the match, and stands with Shizuku when the final is delayed for Ikki and Stella.

key_events.summary: Helps Shizuku ambush Amane and is struck down by Azure blades.
Asks Ikki whether he has a plan and hears Ikki's confidence.
Reports Ikki's collapse and stays near Shizuku during the emergency.
